svg.aria-label: Vector search. An embedding model turns text or images into vectors so that similar meanings land close together. A query is embedded the same way and the index finds its nearest neighbours. A flat index compares against every vector, exact but slow. IVF groups vectors into clusters and searches only the clusters nearest the query. HNSW builds a layered graph and walks from a coarse top layer down to the closest points.
